subject: Who should issue invoices and preferred delivery channel (portal vs email copies)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice origin + delivery channel question

Hi Marissa,

Quick one from our AP team as we begin onboarding Redwood: who will be the invoice originator on your system? Our ERP (Coupa) needs to know whether Redwood will create and push the invoice into our portal, or if you expect us to pull an e-invoice feed from your FTP.

Also two delivery items:
- For our reconciliations we need e-invoice XML (UBL preferred) delivered into our Coupa portal.
- We also like to receive a copy via email to ap@acmehealth.com for the internal approvers (PDF copy is fine as a fallback).

Finally, for EU VAT evidence you can send the VAT certificate to ap@acmehealth.com or include it as an attachment on the first invoice. Is that possible?

Thanks — can someone on your side confirm the process and sample format so we can configure Coupa and the PO routing.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Accounts Payable
Acme Health

[attachment: acme-vat-certificate.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin + delivery channel question

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Internal note: looped in Karthik for e-invoice/schema details and Ben for AP handoff.

Short answers up front:
1) Redwood can act as the invoice originator and push e-invoices (XML) into your Coupa endpoint, OR we can expose a secure SFTP/HTTP feed for you to pull.
2) We can also send an email copy (PDF) to ap@acmehealth.com on invoice generation as a fallback.
3) We can attach VAT evidence on the first invoice and maintain the certificate in the portal.

Options and tradeoffs:
- Push-to-portal (preferred for your Coupa team): lowest manual touch, immediate posting, supports UBL/XML. Requires one-time endpoint setup and an authentication key.
- Pull/SFTP feed: useful if your procurement team wants to ingest on your cadence; requires schedule agreement and a test window.
- Email + PDF: guaranteed delivery to approvers but creates reconciliation extra work. Use as redundancy only.

Action items for us to move forward:
- Please confirm Coupa endpoint URL and preferred file format (UBL/XML vs vendor-specific CSV).
- Provide a test PO or sandbox vendor ID for validation.
- Confirm whether you need signed PDF invoices (PAdES) or unsigned PDFs are OK.

I've attached a short sample XML export and our e-invoice schema (see attachments). If you can share the Coupa test endpoint we can run a test push this week (EST window we can do 1500-1900 UTC).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0137

Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.xml, e-invoice-schema-v2.1.xsd

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin + delivery channel question

Hi Liam / Marissa — quick technical notes from the integrations side (cc Ben for AP sync):

- Our e-invoice export supports UBL 2.1 and a lightweight Redwood JSON-to-UBL mapper. The attached XSD describes the UBL elements we populate (line-level tax, VAT breakdown, PO reference, remit-to).
- For push workflows we support TLS-authenticated HTTPS POST to vendor endpoints and SFTP with key auth. For Coupa many customers accept the HTTPS POST to an integration endpoint.
- Regarding VAT evidence: we can bundle the VAT certificate as an embedded attachment (base64) in the invoice package, or stash the cert in your vendor record in Coupa and reference it via vendor_tax_id. If you need a signed certificate, indicate PAdES or PDF signature requirement.
- Invoice numbering: we can start numbering per customer with prefix RDW-ACME-2026-0001 and carry forward. If you prefer to control numbering, we can emit a draft invoice for you to assign a number and then finalize.

Test plan proposal:
1) You provide a sandbox vendor endpoint + sample PO (or sandbox vendor ID).
2) We run one test invoice push (XML + PDF copy) to your endpoint during the agreed window.
3) You confirm ingest and mapping; we adjust schema mappings.
4) Go-live and switch off email-only fallback.

Questions for you:
- Confirm whether Coupa expects UBL 2.1 or a vendor-specific XML.
- Do you need the VAT cert attached to every invoice or only on the initial invoice and when it changes?
- Any required invoice field mapping (account number, cost center) we should be aware of?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[attachment: e-invoice-schema-v2.1.xsd]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmehealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin + delivery channel question

Marissa / Karthik — thanks, this looks good. Couple quick confirmations: 

- Preferred: Push-to-portal (Coupa HTTPS endpoint) + email copy to ap@acmehealth.com as a redundant delivery.
- Coupa expects UBL 2.1 with standard tax breakdown fields; we will accept the VAT cert on the first invoice and when updated.
- AP asks that PDFs do not need to be PAdES-signed for now.
- Our AP contact (for testing & endpoint creds):
  • Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com> (AP Systems)
  • Test vendor ID: ACME-RDW-TEST-42

I've uploaded our vendor sandbox endpoint and a short PO sample to the DocuSign link (see link) and attached the VAT cert here for your records.

When you push the test invoice, please include the draft invoice number you intend to finalize so we can map it in our sandbox. If you start numbering at RDW-ACME-2026-0001 that's fine; we will sync post-test.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If we can run the test on Friday 23 Jul 1500 UTC that suits the Coupa team.

Regards,
Liam

[attachment: acme-vat-certificate.pdf]
